full_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square transparent research icon for an RTS, readable at 32 pixels. Primary request: Lamanite camp cook placing grain cakes into a red-banded ration basket. Render the subject as: Lamanite camp cook placing grain cakes into a red-banded ration basket. Style/medium: original low-poly toon 3D asset with visibly faceted triangular planes, chunky simplified monumental shapes, clean sculpted silhouettes, miniature diorama quality; not photorealistic, no gritty microtexture. Composition: one centered large subject, icon close-up, no pedestal, no frame. Lighting: warm upper-left key light and cool soft shadows. Palette: #A94636, #D4A34E, #665042. Background: genuinely transparent. Constraints: no text, letters, numerals, labels, watermark, UI, tiny clutter, extra unrelated objects, or cropped subject.
